guides.favoredWhen: Give up nothing early; an even lane is a won game because you outscale him.

keyTips.text: You outscale him, so going even through lane is winning. Refuse coinflip fights for lane pride; every even recall keeps you on your scaling curve while his early window closes.
Shove him under his tower. He cannot answer your push, and a Jhin stuck catching waves cannot hold the short-trade lane he wants.
Force long fights on your chompers. His whole plan is short trades precisely because standing to trade lets you root him under Flame Chompers ({cd:222:E}).

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Open by shoving the first waves. Whoever holds the push decides who gets to trade and who has to catch, so make him the one catching.
Spoil his early-lead plan: give the first plate rather than dying for it. A scoreless lane that you shoved is his loss, not yours, because he needs the lead and you do not.
Stand off the dying-minion line while his fourth shot is loaded. His grenade bounce into the execute shot is his max-damage trade, so concede that cannon rather than eating the combo for it.
Keep the waves shoved through the mid game. Every wave he answers under his tower is a wave he is not pressuring you with.
Seed Flame Chompers ({cd:222:E}) on the objective choke before your team starts it. He has to walk into the roots to contest, which turns his short-trade plan against him.
Drag the game past the laning phase once even. You outscale him, so every minute after his early window closes grows your edge in the fights that follow.
Fight the decisive fight long: kite back through pre-placed chompers instead of bursting. The longer he stands to trade, the more roots he eats.

keyTips.text: Play the first levels safely and fight early only on a clear edge like an engage support.
At level 6, finish low-health opponents with R after skirmishes, even far retreating targets.
Stand behind the team near the support late and kite the nearest enemy instead of chasing riskier targets.

tips.text: With a few levels banked, prefer extended trades over repeated short exchanges.
Budget mana so Q rockets stay ready for long-range last-hits instead of letting enemies zone Jinx off farm.
Spend the first item component on skirmishing, firing Q rockets into clumps with allied peel around.
After the bottom tower, rotate mid and open the map through its tower.
Stick near the support or another ally all mid game; isolation kills Jinx.
Group over split-pushing without a specific reason to leave the team.
Set picks with the support or jungler, then weigh Baron on the resulting numbers edge.
At level 9, deal heavier sustained damage with maxed Q under teammate peel.
Trigger the passive movement and attack-speed window with R finishes on low targets to keep damage rolling.
Keep allies between Jinx and divers; without E to help escape, all-ins stick hard.

itemization.text: Reach core items safely while managing mana.
